title: LGS1920 Studio launch registration
description: Register to receive launch updates and learn how to stay connected afterwards.
registrationIntro: Register to receive launch updates and learn how to stay connected afterwards.

hero.title: Live outdoor adventures. Share the stories.
hero.lead: Walk, run or ride, then bring your route into Studio to edit, replay and share videos without leaving your browser.

panel.title: Your next route deserves a story.
panel.lead: Register for launch updates and be among the first to discover a private-by-default workspace for routes, scenes, videos, and reports.

items.title: Prepare the scene.
items.text: Map layers, camera views, POIs, colors, and widgets.

items.title: Export and share.
items.text: Videos, snapshots, and HTML or PDF reports.

items.title: Private by default
items.text: Your work stays in your browser by default.
items.note: Local synchronization across devices is already possible. A future version may also support your own cloud storage.

items.title: Free today and tomorrow
items.text: Studio is free to use today and will remain free.
items.note: Optional map or data services may be paid by their own providers. Studio has no commercial relationship of any kind with them.

privacy: Your details are used only to contact you about the Studio launch. They are not sold or shared for advertising. You can withdraw your consent or request access, correction, or deletion at any time by writing to studio@lgs1920.fr. We keep your registration data only for the launch information period, then review it.

privacyQuote.title: Your privacy comes first.
privacyQuote.text: With Studio, you don’t need to create an online account to access your data. Your data stays in your personal spaces: your browser, your device, or your own cloud storage. We will never track what you do; we are cookie-free, so use the app however you like.
